purpose: Teach: 伏線/転機/崇/施す/骨太/通り抜け/ろくな/根付い

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、論文、伏線の構造、見事に分析してありますね。
lines.en: Ren — your analysis of the foreshadowing structure in this paper is really impressive.
lines.style: Warm, genuine praise delivered plainly. No artificial encouragement. She means it. Clear eye contact, slight nod at the compliment. Steady pace, letting it land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。主人公の転機、章ごとに区切りました。
lines.en: Yes. I organized it by the protagonist's turning points — one per chapter.
lines.style: Careful, measured. He's laying out his thinking logically, almost to reassure himself it holds up. Slight nervous clarity — speaking to someone whose opinion matters. Respectful attention in his voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 神への崇拝が、物語に深みを与えていますね。
lines.en: The reverence toward god — it really does add depth to the whole narrative.
lines.style: Thinking aloud, genuinely interested. She's noticing something as she speaks it. Slight lift at the end, like an observation she hadn't fully articulated before. Warm, conversational.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。作家が施す手法、独特で面白いです。
lines.en: Yes. The way the author employs that technique is really distinctive.
lines.style: A little more confident now, leaning into the analysis. He's warmed to the conversation. Small breath before the key word. Not defensive, just — present and thinking alongside her.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 骨太なテーマを扱っていますね、卒論の中で。
lines.en: You're dealing with some genuinely substantive themes in this thesis.
lines.style: Affirming, steady. She's taking him seriously as a thinker now, not just a student. Slight emphasis on 'genuinely.' Professional respect, but warm underneath. No condescension.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。読者が時代を通り抜けて、感じ取る作品です。
lines.en: Yes. It's the kind of work where you feel the passage of time, across generations.
lines.style: Quieter, more introspective. He's moved from explaining to feeling. Slower pace. Slight weightlessness on 'feel' — like he's touching something true. Respectful, almost reverent.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ろくな解釈がない論文、世間に多いですが、これは別物ですね。
lines.en: There are so many papers out there with shallow interpretations, but this — this is something else entirely.
lines.style: Clear-eyed honesty. She's drawing a real distinction, not just flattering. Slight pause before the second 'this.' Firm, knowing. The voice of someone who reads a lot and knows the difference.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古典が現代に根付いていく過程、論じました。
lines.en: Yes. I tried to show how the classical elements are taking root in modern times — how they persist.
lines.style: Final thought, grounded. He's brought it home. Steady voice, a little more settled than before. Respectful close, but not deferential. He's said something he believes.
